charts.title: K2-25 b: orbits around K2-25
charts.description: The orbits of K2-25's planets in this map from above, to scale, with K2-25 b highlighted and the direction to Earth down. Each orbit is the one the app draws, from the published period, a/R*, eccentricity and argument of periastron; the star is a marker, not to scale.

metadata.orbitSource: Stefansson et al. 2020 (2020AJ....160..192S), via the NASA Exoplanet Archive ps table (pl_refname STEFANSSON_ET_AL__2020): P 3.48456408 d

charts.title: K2-25 b: its transit
charts.description: K2-25 b crossing its star, as TESS recorded it: 3 sectors (44, 70, 71) of the SPOC pipeline's 2-minute light curves of TIC 434226736, each transit divided by a straight line fitted to the light either side and folded onto the orbit the app draws, then averaged in 4-minute bins. Error bars are each bin's standard error.
notes: Folded on the app's orbit; 4-min bins.
Bars: standard error of each bin.
